title: Research Farm Index
description: Read-only contract consumed by Habitat. Lists research items and the canonical source root. Habitat must read this index and stream files through owner-gated routes instead of scanning the full KB tree.

schema_version.description: Monotonic version of this index contract. Bump on breaking shape change.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last regeneration. null when hand-maintained during Phase 1.

source_root.description: Absolute canonical path to the Research Farm root in slimy-kb.

ui_theme.description: Theme label. Always 'research_farm' — Habitat uses it to pick the right farm/guild vocabulary and visuals.

items.description: All known research records, ordered as Habitat should display them.
